from.place: The torsion-free quotient: finitely generated and torsion-free over the discrete valuation ring ... hence free

title: Finite torsion-free modules over a DVR are free
statement: Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring [def-sc-discrete-valuation-ring] and let $M$ be a finitely generated torsion-free $R$-module. Then $M$ is finite free over $R$.
